manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Faceless Butcher must be exiled by Yannik, and Worldgorger Dragon must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Worldgorger Dragon for its mana cost.
When Worldgorger Dragon enters, it exiles Yannik until Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Worldgorger Dragon's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Worldgorger Dragon until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
